product_overview: Rahma Traveler is a Flask CRM and AI-assisted travel sales backend for managing travelers, trips, bookings, leads, interactions, identity resolution, document uploads, copy templates, and admin operations. It supports operational workflows for travel sales teams, including duplicate detection, handoff management, and health/import diagnostics.
core_goals: Provide reliable CRUD and search APIs for travelers, trips, bookings, leads, interactions, and handoffs.
Enforce business rules for duplicate detection, blacklisted records, passport handling, and booking draft integrity.
Support safe document upload and traveler document viewing with path validation and ownership checks.
Enable identity resolution and human handoff workflows for AI-assisted sales operations.
Expose admin tools for dashboarding, import/sync issue review, duplicate merge, and database health diagnostics.

features.name: Traveler Management
features.description: Manage traveler records, including creation, updates, listing/filtering, export, and document handling with duplicate phone protection.
user_flows: GET /travelers/ with search/filter parameters -> Receive 200 with matching traveler list -> POST /travelers/ with unique traveler data and valid phone_lookup_key -> Receive 201 with new traveler using DB-first ID generation -> GET /travelers/<id>/documents for the new traveler -> Receive 200 with empty or existing document list

POST /travelers/ with a duplicate phone_lookup_key -> Receive 409 or validation error indicating duplicate traveler protection -> GET /travelers/ with the same search criteria -> Receive 200 without creating a second active traveler record

POST /travelers/<id>/documents/upload with allowed image/PDF file and safe filename -> Receive 201 with stored passport/document row -> GET /travelers/<id>/documents/<document_id> -> Receive 200 with document metadata and safe file path

POST /travelers/<id>/documents/upload with path traversal filename or disallowed file type -> Receive 400 or 415 validation error -> GET /travelers/<id>/documents/<document_id> for a document that does not belong to the traveler -> Receive 403 or 404 access denied

features.name: Trip Inventory Management
features.description: List, filter, and maintain trip products, while preserving query state when navigating from list to trip detail and showing capacity details.
user_flows: GET /trips/ with filter parameters for status, destination, or date -> Receive 200 with filtered trip inventory -> GET /trips/<id> -> Receive 200 with trip detail and capacity fields -> Return to GET /trips/ with the same query string -> Receive 200 with persisted filter results
POST /trips/ with required trip product fields -> Receive 201 with created trip record -> GET /trips/<id> -> Receive 200 showing the new trip details
GET /trips/ with invalid filter values -> Receive 400 validation error -> GET /trips/<id> for a non-existent trip -> Receive 404 not found

features.name: Booking Management
features.description: Create booking drafts, search bookings, update booking and payment status, and view booking event/history trails.
user_flows: POST /bookings/ with traveler, trip, room, payment status, passport status, and group-size fields -> Receive 201 with booking draft created -> GET /bookings/ with search term matching booking ID, traveler name, trip name, notes, source, or traveler ID -> Receive 200 with the created booking in results -> GET /bookings/<id>/events or history endpoint -> Receive 200 with booking event/history entries

GET /bookings/ with partial case-insensitive search text such as 'Test Booking' -> Receive 200 with matching bookings -> PATCH /bookings/<id> with payment or booking status updates -> Receive 200 with updated booking state -> GET /bookings/<id>/events -> Receive 200 with appended history trail

POST /bookings/ with missing traveler or trip references -> Receive 400 validation error -> PATCH /bookings/<id> with an invalid status transition -> Receive 400 or 409 error preventing unsafe mutation

features.name: Lead Management and Handoff Creation
features.description: Create, update, search, and manage leads, including converting a lead into a human handoff request when needed.
user_flows: POST /leads/ with valid lead data -> Receive 201 with created lead -> GET /leads/ with search parameters -> Receive 200 with the lead in search results -> POST /leads/<id>/handoff or equivalent handoff-creation route -> Receive 201 with a new pending handoff item
GET /leads/ with partial search text -> Receive 200 with matched lead records -> PATCH /leads/<id> with updated contact or status fields -> Receive 200 with lead updated successfully
POST /leads/ with blacklisted traveler/contact data -> Receive 400 or blocked response due to unsafe creation rule -> POST /leads/<id>/handoff for a non-existent lead -> Receive 404 not found

features.name: Interaction Log Search
features.description: Search interaction logs for CRM activity and retrieve matching communication history.
user_flows: GET /interactions/ with traveler, lead, booking, or keyword filters -> Receive 200 with matching interaction logs -> GET /interactions/ with broader search criteria -> Receive 200 with paginated or filtered log results
GET /interactions/ with invalid filter syntax -> Receive 400 validation error -> GET /interactions/ for a query with no matches -> Receive 200 with an empty result set

features.name: Handoff Queue Workflow
features.description: View, create, assign, update, and resolve AI-to-human handoffs through a queue with pending counts and status transitions.
user_flows: GET /admin/handoffs/ -> Receive 200 with handoff kanban board grouped by status -> GET /admin/handoffs/pending-count -> Receive 200 with count of pending items -> PATCH /admin/handoffs/<id> to move item from Pending to In Progress -> Receive 200 with updated handoff status -> PATCH /admin/handoffs/<id> to move item to Resolved -> Receive 200 with resolved handoff record
POST /admin/handoffs/ with required handoff payload -> Receive 201 with new pending handoff -> GET /admin/handoffs/ -> Receive 200 showing the new item in Pending
PATCH /admin/handoffs/<id> with an invalid status transition -> Receive 400 or 409 error -> PATCH /admin/handoffs/<missing_id> -> Receive 404 not found

features.name: Admin Dashboard, Import, and Health
features.description: Provide operational admin views for dashboard metrics, import/sync issue review, duplicate identity review and merge, and database health diagnostics.
user_flows: GET /admin/ -> Receive 200 with dashboard summary -> GET /admin/health -> Receive 200 with database health diagnostics -> GET /admin/import or sync issue view -> Receive 200 with import/sync status information

GET /admin/duplicates -> Receive 200 with duplicate identity candidates -> POST /api/crm/duplicates/scan or equivalent duplicate scan endpoint -> Receive 200 with detected duplicate pairs -> POST /api/crm/merge or equivalent merge endpoint with valid merge target -> Receive 200 with merged identity result

GET /admin/health with database connectivity failure -> Receive 503 or error response indicating health check failure -> POST /api/crm/merge with invalid identity IDs -> Receive 400 or 404 validation error

features.name: Identity Resolution API
features.description: Detect duplicate traveler identities and merge records using CRM identity APIs.
user_flows: POST /api/crm/duplicates/scan with scan criteria -> Receive 200 with duplicate traveler candidates based on phone_lookup_key -> POST /api/crm/merge with source and target identity identifiers -> Receive 200 with successful merge result -> GET /travelers/ with updated data -> Receive 200 reflecting merged identity state
POST /api/crm/duplicates/scan with no matching duplicates -> Receive 200 with empty duplicate list -> POST /api/crm/merge with mismatched or missing IDs -> Receive 400 or 404 error

features.name: Copy Template Rendering
features.description: List deterministic copy templates and render a template with provided variables for sales or AI-assisted messaging.
user_flows: GET /api/copy/templates -> Receive 200 with available copy template list -> POST /api/copy/render with template name and variables -> Receive 200 with rendered deterministic copy output
POST /api/copy/render with missing variables or unknown template -> Receive 400 validation error -> GET /api/copy/templates -> Receive 200 confirming available templates remain accessible

critical_behaviors: trip filter persistence through detail navigation
booking search across booking ID, traveler name, trip name, notes, source, and traveler ID
booking draft creation with group size, passport status, and payment status
safe document upload and document view path validation
